class.name: UZUSfx
class.brief_description: Synthesizes game sound effects from a few parameters, without sound files.
class.description: [UZUSfx] makes short game sounds (hits, jumps, pickups, explosions) in the style of the sfxr family of tools. A sound is a waveform whose pitch slides and jumps, shaped by an envelope and an optional low-pass filter. The result is a 16-bit mono [AudioStreamWAV]. A table of presets gives starting points, and a seed varies them a little. [method play] plays a sound once, with a small random change of pitch and volume, so repeated sounds do not feel mechanical. [method describe] reports what a sound is like (length, peak, loudness, pitch at the start and the end), for an agent that cannot listen. Several presets can also be packed into one audio sprite — a single [AudioStreamWAV] with a manifest of segments — with [method generate_sprite] or [method build_sprite], and one segment of it played with [method play_sprite]. [codeblock] var coin = UZUSfx.generate_preset("coin", 3) UZUSfx.play(self, coin) var params = UZUSfx.get_preset("laser") params["decay"] = 0.4 var longer_laser = UZUSfx.generate(params) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] This class is specific to U.ZU Engine (UZUJuice).

method.name: describe
method.description: Describes a 16-bit mono [param stream]: [code]length[/code] (seconds), [code]peak[/code] and [code]rms[/code] (0..1), [code]pitch_start[/code] and [code]pitch_end[/code] (zero crossings per second over the first and the last fifth; about twice the pitch for a tone, high for noise), and [code]ends_silent[/code] (the last millisecond is under 5% of the peak, so it ends without a click).

method.name: generate
method.description: Makes a sound from [param params]. Missing parameters take their defaults (see [method get_defaults]): - [code]wave[/code]: [code]"square"[/code], [code]"saw"[/code], [code]"sine"[/code], [code]"triangle"[/code] or [code]"noise"[/code]. - [code]frequency[/code] and [code]frequency_end[/code]: the pitch in Hz at the start and the end. It slides evenly in octaves between them. - [code]change_ratio[/code] and [code]change_time[/code]: the pitch is multiplied by the ratio after that many seconds (the jump of a coin sound). - [code]vibrato_depth[/code] (semitones) and [code]vibrato_speed[/code] (Hz). - [code]duty[/code] and [code]duty_sweep[/code]: the share of the square wave that is high, and its change per second. - [code]attack[/code], [code]sustain[/code] and [code]decay[/code]: the envelope, in seconds. [code]punch[/code] (0..1) makes the start of the sustain louder. - [code]lowpass[/code]: 1 is off; lower values sound darker. - [code]volume[/code] (0..1), [code]seed[/code] (for noise) and [code]sample_rate[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] with an error for an unknown parameter, an unknown wave, or a length that is 0 or longer than 10 seconds.

method.name: generate_preset
method.description: Makes the sound of a preset: [method generate] with [method get_preset].

method.name: get_defaults
method.description: Returns every parameter of [method generate] with its default value.

method.name: get_preset
method.description: Returns the parameters of a preset, ready to change and pass to [method generate]. Seed 0 is the preset as written. Other seeds shift its pitch (up to a fifth of an octave) and length (up to 15%) a little, always the same way for the same seed. Returns an empty [Dictionary] with an error for an unknown name.

method.name: get_preset_names
method.description: Returns the names of the presets: [code]hit[/code], [code]jump[/code], [code]pickup[/code], [code]coin[/code], [code]explosion[/code], [code]laser[/code], [code]powerup[/code], [code]blip[/code] and [code]land[/code].

method.name: build_sprite
method.description: Builds an audio sprite in one call: returns a [Dictionary] with [code]stream[/code] (the packed [AudioStreamWAV]), [code]manifest[/code] (see [method sprite_manifest]), [code]sample_rate[/code], [code]gap_ms[/code], [code]gap_samples[/code], [code]total_samples[/code] and [code]total_sec[/code]. Returns an empty [Dictionary] with an error for an unknown preset or an empty name list.

method.name: generate_sprite
method.description: Packs the named presets into one 16-bit mono [AudioStreamWAV], in order, with [param gap_ms] milliseconds of silence between neighbours (not before the first or after the last). Deterministic: the same names, gap and seed give the same samples. Use [method sprite_manifest] for the segment of each name, and [method play_sprite] to play one segment.

method.name: get_sprite_segment
method.description: Returns the segment of [param name] in a sprite [param manifest]: [code]start_sample[/code], [code]length_samples[/code], [code]end_sample[/code], [code]start_sec[/code], [code]duration_sec[/code] and [code]end_sec[/code]. Returns an empty [Dictionary] when the manifest has no such name.

method.name: play
method.description: Adds an [AudioStreamPlayer] under [param parent] that plays [param stream] once and frees itself when it has finished. Its pitch scale is 1 ± [param pitch_jitter], and its volume is [param volume_db] ± [param volume_jitter_db], both chosen at random. It starts when [param parent] is in the scene tree.

method.name: play_sprite
method.description: Plays only the segment of [param name] of a sprite built by [method generate_sprite] or [method build_sprite]: adds an [AudioStreamPlayer] under [param parent] that starts at the segment and is stopped and freed at its end by the sprite runtime node. The segment is kept in the player's [code]uzu_sprite_segment[/code] metadata. Returns [code]null[/code] with an error when the manifest has no such segment.

method.name: sprite_manifest
method.description: Returns where each named preset sits in the sprite that [method generate_sprite] builds with the same arguments: a [Dictionary] mapping each name to its segment (see [method get_sprite_segment]). This is a pure computation from the preset parameters — it needs no AudioServer and always agrees with the generated stream, because both come from the same segment computation. A repeated name keeps its first segment. Returns an empty [Dictionary] with an error for an unknown preset or an empty name list.

method.name: sprite_should_stop
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once a player at [param playback_pos_sec] seconds has reached the end of [param segment] and must stop (the pure stop condition that segment playback uses). An empty segment always returns [code]true[/code].
